summary: This code renders a card component with an image and a footer containing three action buttons (Like, Comment, Share). The card is placed inside a responsive grid layout that takes up half the width of its container, with some padding below it.

explanations.7: col--6 means this column takes up 6 out of 12 grid columns, which is exactly half the width of its parent container.
explanations.12: This inline style object sets the background color to a greenish shade and text color to yellow for the card footer.
explanations.15: button-group--block makes the buttons stretch to fill their container width and stack responsively.
